title: Breanna K. Nguyễn
text: Hi! I am currently a senior research data tech in the Moral Attitudes and Decisions Lab and an incoming Ph.D. Student at Duke University. I have a strong passion for research and am always seeking opportunities to expand my knowledge and skills. I am broadly interested in moral cognition, computational modeling of cognitive processes, and data science.
